# Expressions of any depth are rewritten. The product of two scalars is
# broadcast once before the loop, a scalar on the left of a subtraction is not
# swapped, a fill takes any loop-invariant value, and a shift applies to a whole
# expression.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

// Depth 4: the histogram merge shape.
func Merge(h, h0, h1, h2, h3 []uint16) {
	for i := range h {
		h[i] += h0[i] + h1[i] + h2[i] + h3[i]
	}
}

// The product of two scalars is computed once, before the loop.
func Poly(dst, a, b, c []int32, k, m int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i]*b[i] + c[i]*k + (k*m - a[i])
	}
}

// A scalar on the left of a subtraction is not swapped.
func SubFrom(dst, a []float64, k float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = k - a[i]
	}
}

func FillVar(dst []float64, k float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = k
	}
}

func ShiftSum(dst, a, b []uint32, n uint) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = (a[i] + b[i]) << n
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

// Depth 4: the histogram merge shape.
func Merge(h, h0, h1, h2, h3 []uint16) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(h, h0) || _loopvecOverlap(h, h1) || _loopvecOverlap(h, h2) || _loopvecOverlap(h, h3) {
		for i := range h {
			h[i] += h0[i] + h1[i] + h2[i] + h3[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(h) > 0 {
			_ = h0[len(h)-1]
			_ = h1[len(h)-1]
			_ = h2[len(h)-1]
			_ = h3[len(h)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(h); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadUint16sPart(h0[_i:])
				_v2, _ := simd.LoadUint16sPart(h1[_i:])
				_v3, _ := simd.LoadUint16sPart(h2[_i:])
				_v4, _ := simd.LoadUint16sPart(h3[_i:])
				_v5, _ := simd.LoadUint16sPart(h[_i:])
				_v1.Add(_v2).Add(_v3).Add(_v4).Add(_v5).StorePart(h[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

// The product of two scalars is computed once, before the loop.
func Poly(dst, a, b, c []int32, k, m int32) {
	_vcInt32s1_1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(k)
	_vcInt32s1_2 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(k * m)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, c) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i]*b[i] + c[i]*k + (k*m - a[i])
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			_ = c[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(a[_i:])
				_v2, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(b[_i:])
				_v3, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(c[_i:])
				_v1.Mul(_v2).Add(_v3.Mul(_vcInt32s1_1)).Add(_vcInt32s1_2.Sub(_v1)).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

// A scalar on the left of a subtraction is not swapped.
func SubFrom(dst, a []float64, k float64) {
	_vcFloat64s2 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(k)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = k - a[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(a[_i:])
				_vcFloat64s2.Sub(_v1).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func FillVar(dst []float64, k float64) {
	_vcFloat64s3 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(k)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s3.StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func ShiftSum(dst, a, b []uint32, n uint) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = (a[i] + b[i]) << n
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadUint32sPart(a[_i:])
				_v2, _ := simd.LoadUint32sPart(b[_i:])
				_v1.Add(_v2).ShiftAllLeft(uint64(n)).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T) bool {
	if len(a) == 0 || len(b) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	aStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	aEnd := aStart + uintptr(len(a))*unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	bStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	bEnd := bStart + uintptr(len(b))*unsafe.Sizeof(b[0])
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func u16(n int, scale uint16) []uint16 {
	s := make([]uint16, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = uint16(i+1) * scale
	}
	return s
}

func i32(n int, scale int32) []int32 {
	s := make([]int32, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = int32(i+1) * scale
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	// Several vectors and a tail.
	h := u16(11, 1000)
	test.Merge(h, u16(11, 3000), u16(11, 7000), u16(11, 9000), u16(11, 11000))
	fmt.Println(h)

	dst := make([]int32, 11)
	test.Poly(dst, i32(11, 2), i32(11, 3), i32(11, 5), 7, 11)
	fmt.Println(dst)

	f := make([]float64, 11)
	a := make([]float64, 11)
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = float64(i) * 0.5
	}
	test.SubFrom(f, a, 2.5)
	fmt.Println(f)
	test.FillVar(f, -1.25)
	fmt.Println(f)

	u := make([]uint32, 11)
	x := make([]uint32, 11)
	y := make([]uint32, 11)
	for i := range x {
		x[i], y[i] = uint32(i), uint32(i*i)
	}
	test.ShiftSum(u, x, y, 3)
	fmt.Println(u)
}
-- testmain/output --
[31000 62000 27464 58464 23928 54928 20392 51392 16856 47856 13320]
[116 167 230 305 392 491 602 725 860 1007 1166]
[2.5 2 1.5 1 0.5 0 -0.5 -1 -1.5 -2 -2.5]
[-1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25]
[0 16 48 96 160 240 336 448 576 720 880]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 5 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

// Depth 4: the histogram merge shape.
func Merge(h, h0, h1, h2, h3 []uint16) {
	for i := range h {
		h[i] += h0[i] + h1[i] + h2[i] + h3[i]
	}
}

// The product of two scalars is computed once, before the loop.
func Poly(dst, a, b, c []int32, k, m int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i]*b[i] + c[i]*k + (k*m - a[i])
	}
}

// A scalar on the left of a subtraction is not swapped.
func SubFrom(dst, a []float64, k float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = k - a[i]
	}
}

func FillVar(dst []float64, k float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = k
	}
}

func ShiftSum(dst, a, b []uint32, n uint) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = (a[i] + b[i]) << n
	}
}
